_doc: Notional Labor-v-Coalition two-party figures for NSW Legislative Assembly districts whose final count wasn't Labor v Coalition. Rows are [alp_votes, coalition_votes]. Provenance and verification trail: .build/map/src/nsw/notional-adjudication.md. NSWEC publishes no 2CP beyond the finals — but since 2015 it has data-entered every ballot and ships an on-demand preference-distribution TOOL; the per-district Labor-Coalition pairs below are that tool's own output, published in Antony Green's 2023 election research paper (NSW Parliamentary Library's Research Paper 7/2025). Do not edit by hand without the set checks in build_nsw23_data.py passing.

nsw23.credit: The per-district two-party-preferred rows of Antony Green's 2023 NSW election analysis (Research Paper 7/2025 update of 11/2023; his table note: totals 'derived from the [NSW Electoral] Commission's on-line [preference-distribution] tool')
